title: Step 2: Read Them All
story: One line works. Now a whole file's worth.
goal: Add parse_all(text) that parses every non-blank line.

tests.label: Parses every line
tests.expr:
len(parse_all('2025-01-05 10:00:01 INFO server started
2025-01-05 10:00:07 ERROR disk full
2025-01-05 10:01:00 WARN slow query

2025-01-05 10:02:11 ERROR disk full
2025-01-05 10:03:09 ERROR timeout
2025-01-05 10:04:00 INFO request ok'))

hints: Use text.splitlines() and skip blank ones.
A list comprehension with an if is short.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
